en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet small‑town street with people pushing handcarts along a cobbled road. On the left corner stands a two‑storey building with signs for a business named "Moritz Henker" and the establishment "Zur Börse"; another painted sign partially visible reads "Bäckerei" on an adjacent wall. Traditional half‑timbered houses, telegraph poles, and a large ornate streetlamp line the road, which recedes toward a church‑like building in the background.
